name: Pink Rose
source:
Flowers bloom, but not every one of them is destined to last long.  

Fujioka has been secretly tending a rose in the depths of their heart.  

Will it ever blossom? Or will it wilt alongside that moment at the bus stop?

[From [url=https://st-chem-atelier.itch.io/pinkrose-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
鲜花盛开，但并不是每一朵都注定能长久。

藤冈一直在他们的内心深处偷偷地照顾着一朵玫瑰。

它会永远开花吗？或者它会随着公交车站的那一刻而枯萎吗？

[来自[url=https://st-chem-atelier.itch.io/pinkrose-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
